weapons.name: SIG P229}} The is a full-sized, service-type pistol made by SIG Sauer. Introduced in 1992, it is a variant of the P228 which itself is a variant of the P226. Developed specifically for the US market, the P229 features a heavier slide to tolerate more powerful rounds the P228 is incapable of. The P229 differs from the P226 in several respects, and was originally introduced to supplement and then replace the P228 by adding the .357 SIG and .40 S&W as available chamberings.
